business.about: KPIT is a global technology company with software solutions that will help mobility leapfrog towards autonomous, clean, smart and connected future. With 13000+ Automobelievers across the globe,  specializing in embedded software, AI & Digital solutions, KPIT enables customers accelerate implementation of next generation mobility technologies . With development centers in Europe, USA, Japan, China, Thailand and India [1]

promises.opening: welcome to KPIT Technologies Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call hosted by Dolat Capital. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on your touchtone phone. Please note this conference is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Mr. Rahul Jain. Thank you and over to you, sir. Rahul Jain: Thank you, Nazneen. Good evening, everyone. On behalf of Dolat Capital, I would like to thank KPIT Technologies for giving us the opportunity to host this earnings call. And now I would like to hand the conference over to Mr. Sunil Phansalkar, who is Vice President, CF&G and Head of IR at KPIT to do the management introductions. Over to you, Sunil. Sunil Phansalkar: Thank you, Rahul. A warm welcome to all on the KPIT Q2 FY27 Post Earnings Conference Call. I would like to take this opportunity to wish all of you in advance a very happy Diwali and a prosperous New Year. On the call today, we have Mr. Kishor Patil, Co-founder, CEO and MD; Mr. Sachin Tikekar, President and Joint MD; Anup Sable, Board Member and COO; Chinmay Pandit, Board Member and Head Americas; Priyamvada Hardikar CFO and yours truly from IR. So, as we do always, we will have the opening remarks by Mr. Kishor Patil on the performance of the quarter and the way we look at the year ahead and then we will have it open for questions. So, once again, a very warm welcome to you all and I will hand this over to Mr. Kishor Patil. Kishor Patil: Good evening and thank you for joining the call. Welcome to quarter 2 Earnings call. Sometime back, we had given how KPIT growth will pan out and specifically in terms of how Q2 will look like. And we are happy that we are in line with our expectations and we can see some of the early results of the strategy we have put in place. So in order to really understand this, let's go into the details. So, overall growth has been 6.5% year-on-year and 1%, in terms of quarter-on-quarter, in rupee terms. We were expecting more flattish in CC terms, which came at 0.5% quarter-on-quarter and 0.2% year-on-year. So, looking at this, if we go one level below, off highway and Commercial has grown 27% year-on-year and 17.6% quarter-on-quarter. So as we had mentioned, this is one of the growth drivers for now and for the future that we are looking at. The passenger car, if you really look at it, we are down by about 8% year-on-year and 4% sequentially. I would like to mention here that while passenger car growth looks like this, if we take out KPIT Technologies Limited October 28, 2026 Page 3 of 20 our two top accounts, where we had an impact due to a sharp decline we had due to cancellation of their programs or cutting off their expense was 13% of the total revenue. So what this means is we have been in a position to make up that drop due to our growth in off-highway and Commercial vehicles and also from the Products . So, this is how we have been in a position to make up. The pipeline is healthy. We have got reasonable wins and now 89% of the wins have come from target accounts. The pipeline is an active pipeline and we see that while it is taking some time for realization, it is an active pipeline and we feel much more comfortable with some of the opportunities on hand. I would like to come back to the Products. The Products revenue which we have talked about in the past and we will talk more about this later in the year, maybe early next year, in more detail what we intend to do. But this we have a 5% growth quarter-on-quarter during the quarter and 25% year-on-year. So overall services revenue has been flattish, but Products have grown 5% quarter-on-quarter and 25% year-on-year.
